_comment: A FAIL whose case id matches 'pattern' (regex) is reported as KNOWN instead of FAIL, only while production/qa/bugs/<bug>.md exists and its Status line is not Fixed/Closed. With 'findings' (regex), the case is KNOWN only if EVERY finding line of the FAIL matches the findings of some entry for that case; any other line keeps it FAIL. Never invent an id: only bug files allocated by /weekly-wrapup. Remove an entry once the bug is fixed and the case passes.
